verdict.rationale: Codex docs explicitly describe sandboxing: cloud tasks run in isolated environments (codex-docs-1) and the CLI lets users choose when Codex can edit files or run commands without asking, and inspect the active sandbox and writable roots (codex-docs-17), directly matching the engineering-lead's need for sandboxed code/tool/network interaction. Community commentary raises some unease about how tightly sandboxed the agent really is (codex-comm-7, codex-comm-10), but no concrete evidence contradicts the documented sandbox controls.
